description: A LightningJS component defining the UI for a shopping cart panel, including rendering of cart entries, total calculation, and order confirmation modal.

methods.name: $inc
methods.description: Increases the quantity of a given cart item by one and updates the store.

methods.name: $dec
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a given cart item by one and updates the store.

methods.name: $remove
methods.description: Removes a specified item from the cart store.

methods.name: $clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart store.

methods.name: $checkout
methods.description: Handles the checkout process, clears cart, and shows order confirmation modal.

methods.name: $closeConfirm
methods.description: Closes the order confirmation modal after a delay.
